meta.name: comparison-post-writer
meta.description: Write "X vs Y" comparison blog posts that help readers choose between two competing products. Triggers on: "write a comparison post", "X vs Y blog post", "compare [product A] and [product B]", "which is better [A] or [B]", "head to head comparison", "[product] vs [product] article", "comparison review", "write a versus article", "side by side comparison blog", "which should I choose [A] or [B]", "compare these two products for my blog".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 快速生成产品对比博客文章，帮读者做选择。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要定期发布产品对比文章吸引读者。
copy.tagline_en: Generate product comparison blog posts quickly to help readers decide.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to regularly publish comparison articles to engage readers.

howto.what: 安装后，当用户要求比较两个产品时，Claude会撰写完整的“X vs Y”对比博客文章，包含特征对比表、各自优劣势、赢家推荐以及联盟链接。文章结构固定并适配SEO。
howto.when: 当用户说出“写一篇对比文章”、“X vs Y 博客文章”、“比较[产品A]和[产品B]”等包含“vs”、“对比”或“哪个更好”的指令时触发。

say.text: 写一篇Notion vs Obsidian的对比文章。
say.note: 会产出完整对比博文，含推荐。
会自动研究并给出赢家。

say.text: 我需要一篇Synthesia和HeyGen的对照评测。
say.note: 会按标准格式生成文章。

howto.what_en: When activated, Claude writes full 'X vs Y' comparison blog posts with feature tables, pros/cons, winner recommendation, and affiliate CTAs. It adapts the article structure for SEO and reader decision-making.
howto.when_en: When you say 'write a comparison post', 'X vs Y blog post', 'compare [A] and [B]', or similar phrases involving 'vs', 'versus', 'compare', 'which is better', 'side by side'.

say_en.text: Write a comparison post: Notion vs Obsidian.
say_en.note: Produces a full comparison article with winner recommendation.

say_en.text: Compare Airtable and Monday.com – which is better?
say_en.note: Automatically researches both and declares a winner.

say_en.text: I need a side-by-side review of Synthesia and HeyGen.
say_en.note: Generates a structured comparison blog post.
